items.title: Hospitalised for toxic levels of lithium in my system
items.text:
Hospitalised for toxic levels of lithium in my system
I became sick about a week ago, gastrointestinal issues sprung up and got so bad I was vomiting constantly. I couldn't get water down, zero food or I'd immediately throw up. 

It got worse and worse. Vomitting excelled to throwing up 15 or more times a day, by last Thursday I couldn't keep anything down, my vision was blurring and I started slurring words, walking funny, so my wonderful mum drove me to hospital. 

Blood tests showed I had a litium level of 2.5 so I was admitted immediately recived a ultrasound (external and the fun internal wand y'all gals know how much fun that is), ct w/o contrast, then was given and EKG and put on a heart monitor.

They flushed my system, I feel so much better now. I just got out and glad to be home I'm just worried my levels may spike again but keeping an eye on it and my family is very supportive. Helps a lot that I have people who understand and care. 

Anyways, I've rambled enough, just glad to feel better now. My only worry is that as I continue my meds the level may rise. Lithium has saved my life even with this hurrdle I couldn't imagine stopping and becoming suicidal again. Wish me luck guys! 

Thanks for reading!
u/notescher was correct it was extreme dehydration. Levels got better after treatment and 6 liters of saline IV!

A guy in my class with a very confused face and confused inflection in his voice said "Wait straight people can get AIDS to? I thought it was just gays"
